image:image.image:title: Francine Marie Bautista official entrepreneur and founder profile
image:image.image:caption: Francine Marie Bautista, also known as FMB, is a Filipina entrepreneur, founder, creative director, brand strategist, public relations practitioner, educator and digital venture builder.

image:image.image:title: Francine Marie Bautista, transgender woman from Masinloc, Zambales
image:image.image:caption: Francine Marie Bautista is a Masinloqueña transgender woman from Masinloc, Zambales whose work includes entrepreneurship, communications, digital solutions, education, pageantry, history, philanthropy and community service.
